## Introduction

This report describes quarterly sector performance, methods, and reporting conventions.


## Administrative and market overview

The Authority collects information from licensed operators using established reporting procedures. This section describes the scope, definitions, reporting framework, and general development of communications services in Kenya. Data is presented for context and should be read together with the relevant period and unit labels.

## Mobile devices — reporting period April to June 2026 (Q4 FY 2025/2026)

| Device category | Connected devices (millions) | Share of connected mobile devices |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Smartphones | 52.3 | 63.7% |
| Total mobile phone devices | 78.7 | 100% |

At the end of June 2026, 52.3 million smartphones were connected to Kenyan mobile networks. Smartphones represented 63.7 percent of 78.7 million connected mobile phone devices.
